intro: For ten years, we've worked alongside communities, governments and partners to strengthen health systems, expand access to care, and build healthier futures. Now, we are building what comes next.
ceo: Ten years ago, we started with one belief: that lasting change in health begins inside communities, not outside them.

Everything we've built since — every milestone, every life reached — belongs as much to them as to us: frontline health workers, government partners, researchers, donors, and the countless people who chose to stand with this work.

We mark this decade with gratitude. As we enter the next, we do so with renewed resolve. Public health is changing rapidly, and so must we — with deeper partnerships, stronger systems, bolder innovation, and one unwavering commitment: ensuring that every person has the opportunity to live a healthier and more dignified life.
Thank you for walking this journey with us. The best of PPHF is still ahead.

timeline.title: PPHF Founded
timeline.text: A locally driven public health and well-being platform, anchoring equitable access to better health through solutions designed and led by communities themselves.

timeline.title: Community Mobilization
timeline.text: Frontline health workers trained on diabetes and hypertension through the Positive Deviance approach, building peer support, psychosocial care and treatment adherence.

timeline.title: NCD Model Demonstration
timeline.text: A comprehensive prevention-to-care model proved the concept of embedding behaviour change, screening, health-worker training and patient peer groups within public health systems.

timeline.title: Policy Translation
timeline.text: NCD field learning became an implementation toolbox, policy briefs and technical convenings, moving PPHF from programme delivery to evidence-to-policy influence.

timeline.title: Rebranding as PPHF
timeline.text: People to People Health Foundation sharpened its institutional identity around a clear promise: "Catalyzing change for wellbeing."

timeline.title: COVID-19 & "Together for Rare"
timeline.text: Emergency response sharpened agility in supporting health facilities and vulnerable groups, while the rare-disease platform convened governments, policymakers and partners.

timeline.title: Digital Transformation
timeline.text: Post-pandemic digital adoption became integral to improving health-service delivery and reducing access barriers for last-mile communities.

timeline.title: Multi-State Expansion
timeline.text: A comprehensive primary healthcare platform reached over 9 lakh people across NCDs, women/adolescent/child health, nutrition, environmental health and emergency response.

timeline.title: AI-Enabled Health Systems
timeline.text: Innovative AI-based digital technologies deployed within healthcare infrastructure to improve accessibility.

timeline.title: Strategy 2030 Launch
timeline.text: Five thematic priorities set to reach 30M lives impacted and 5M people annually, driven by Technology, Teamwork & Trust.

milestones.title: Strengthening Systems
milestones.text: Building stronger public health infrastructure and frontline capacity.

milestones.title: Shaping Policy
milestones.text: Turning evidence into national and state-level action.

milestones.title: Driving Innovation
milestones.text: Digital health, AI-enabled tools and locally relevant solutions.

milestones.title: Expanding Reach
milestones.text: Growing into new states and underserved communities.

milestones.title: Building Partnerships
milestones.text: Bringing together government, academia, communities and industry.

milestones.title: National Recognition
milestones.text: Independent recognition of quality, credibility and impact.

focus.title: Non-Communicable Diseases
focus.text: We apply a continuum-of-care approach to prevent and manage NCDs — including obesity, diabetes, hypertension, cancers and cardiovascular disease.

focus.title: Nutrition
focus.text: We work to improve nutrition outcomes across every life stage, from infancy to old age.

focus.title: Women, Adolescent, and Child Health
focus.text: We deliver community-based solutions that connect adolescent girls, mothers and children to essential health care.

focus.title: Integrated Development for Health and Wellbeing
focus.text: PPHF drives transformative social impact by providing innovative, evidence-based and sustainable development solutions for health and wellbeing of people.

focus.title: Infectious Diseases
focus.text: We strengthen community and health-system readiness to prevent, detect and respond to infectious disease outbreaks.

focus.title: Environmental Health
focus.text: Environmental health is an essential part of our public health approach. We focus on three areas, including WASH — Water, Sanitation, and Hygiene.

next: PPHF@10 is more than a celebration of what we've achieved. It is the beginning of our next chapter — one that builds on ten years of learning to create even greater impact through innovation, partnerships, evidence and stronger health systems.

Catalysing Change 2036 is PPHF's commitment to reach millions more Indians with better health — by expanding into new geographies, deepening digital health integration, sharpening focus on equity for underserved communities, and forging new partnerships.
It builds on a decade of evidence-led work to define a more connected, technology-enabled and equity-driven path for India's health and well-being through 2036.
